hero.headline: Your Life Story as a Real Book
hero.subtext: With AI-powered interviews, Zeitgeist helps you preserve your memories as a personal biography — and ship it to your door as a printed book.

how.title: How it works
how.step1Text: Answer questions about your life. The AI guides you through childhood, career, family and more.
how.step2Text: Your answers are automatically turned into a personal, literary biography.
how.step3Text: Download your biography as a PDF or have a printed book delivered to your door.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How long does the interview take?
faq.a1: The interview can take as long as you like — typically 3–10 hours spread across multiple sessions. You can pause and continue at any time.
faq.q2: What language can I write my biography in?
faq.a2: Zeitgeist currently supports German, English, French, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Turkish and Russian.
faq.q3: How is the book printed and delivered?
faq.a3: The book is professionally printed and bound. Delivery takes 10–14 working days within Germany and the EU.
faq.q4: Can I edit my biography later?
faq.a4: Yes, you can edit your biography at any time in the app and generate a new version.
faq.a5: Your data is stored encrypted and never shared with third parties. We only store what is necessary for creating your biography.
faq.a6: You have a 14-day right of withdrawal after purchase. For any questions, contact us at support.zeitgeist@gmail.com.

footer.tagline: Your life story deserves to be told.
